verses.english: Linked Discourses 2.20
2. With Anāthapiṇḍika
With Anāthapiṇḍika

verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ ṭhito kho anāthapiṇḍiko devaputto bhagavato santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi:
verses.english: Standing to one side, the godling Anāthapiṇḍika recited these verses in the Buddha’s presence:
“This is indeed that Jeta’s Grove,
frequented by the Saṅgha of seers,
where the King of Dhamma stayed:
it brings me joy!
Deeds, knowledge, and principle;
ethical conduct, an excellent livelihood;
by these are mortals purified,
not by clan or wealth.
That’s why an astute person,
seeing what’s good for themselves,
would examine the teaching rationally,
and thus be purified in it.
Sāriputta is full of wisdom,
ethics, and peace.
Even a mendicant who has crossed over
might at best equal him.”
This is what the godling Anāthapiṇḍika said.

verses.pali: Idaṁ vatvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṁ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
verses.english: Then he bowed and respectfully circled the Buddha, keeping him on his right side, before vanishing right there.

verses.pali: Atha kho bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi:
verses.english: Then, when the night had passed, the Buddha addressed the mendicants:

verses.pali: “imaṁ, bhikkhave, rattiṁ aññataro devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṁ jetavanaṁ obhāsetvā yenāhaṁ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā maṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ aṭṭhāsi.
verses.english: “Mendicants, tonight, a certain glorious godling, lighting up the entire Jeta’s Grove, came to me, bowed, stood to one side,

verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ ṭhito kho, bhikkhave, so devaputto mama santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi:
verses.english: and recited these verses in my presence.” The Buddha then repeated the verses in full.

verses.pali: Idaṁ vatvā maṁ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṁ katvā tatthevantaradhāyī”ti.
Evaṁ vutte, āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When he said this, Venerable Ānanda said to the Buddha,

verses.pali: “so hi nūna, bhante, anāthapiṇḍiko devaputto bhavissati.
verses.english: “Sir, that godling must surely have been Anāthapiṇḍika.

verses.pali: Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati āyasmante sāriputte abhippasanno ahosī”ti.
verses.english: For the householder Anāthapiṇḍika was devoted to Venerable Sāriputta.”

verses.pali: “Sādhu sādhu, ānanda, yāvatakaṁ kho, ānanda, takkāya pattabbaṁ anuppattaṁ taṁ tayā.
verses.english: “Good, good, Ānanda. You’ve reached the logical conclusion, as far as logic goes.
For that was indeed the godling Anāthapiṇḍika.”
